description: Remember a decision so a later session does not redo it. 'fixed_pending' means you changed something and it is not deployed or confirmed yet; 'ignored' silences a finding and requires a reason; 'open' undoes either. You cannot set 'verified': that is earned by calling verify_findings against the live site. Free: does not use a credit.

ignored_until.description: ISO timestamp when an ignore should lapse. Omit to ignore indefinitely.

reason.description: Why. Required when ignoring, and worth writing for the next session.

status.description: 'fixed_pending' after making a change, 'ignored' to silence it, 'open' to undo

name: update_finding
title: Record what you did about a finding
